info.desc: Come On Over is the third studio album recorded by Canadian country music singer Shania Twain. It was released on November 4, 1997, and became the best-selling country album, best-selling studio album by a female artist and best selling album by a Canadian. It is the ninth all-time best-selling album in the United States, and worldwide. It is also the sixteenth best-selling album in the United Kingdom. As of 2020, Come On Over has sold more than 40 million copies worldwide, shipped over 20 million copies in the United States, with over 15.7 million copies sold according to Nielsen SoundScan, .

podcast.body: This album by Shania Twain achieved extraordinary success, selling 40 million copies worldwide and earning it the distinction of being the eighth best-selling album of all time. Its massive global sales positioned Twain as one of three Canadians with the biggest-selling albums in the 1990s, demonstrating the unparalleled international impact of Canadian music.
